html: Check your hot-water need: SharkNinja's US comparison lists espresso, drip and rapid cold brew for ES601; ES701 Pro adds hot water. If Americanos or tea are daily drinks, do not infer a dedicated hot-water mode from the Premier's steam wand. Compare the exact controls before buying. Checked October 21, 2026. [source]
note: US product comparison distinguishes ES601 three-mode brewing from ES701 four-mode brewing with hot water.

html: Software state now matters to a Series 1 handover: Fellow lists firmware 2.5.15, released in stages, with separate System and Precise Calibration flows, a long-press steam-wand purge, and fixes for group rinse, maintenance counters and descaling interruptions. A secondhand buyer should record the installed version in Settings, ask whether an update completed, and test the actual cleaning and calibration menus before relying on a seller's account of them. Staged rollout means a machine without 2.5.15 is not automatically faulty. These are Fellow's release notes, not Coffeedant verification of a particular unit or a reliability rate. Checked October 21, 2026. [source]
note: October 8 Fellow release notes identify staged 2.5.15 rollout, calibration, purge and cleaning/descale fixes.

html: Prepare the BES995 for transit: its US guide lists an on-screen Empty Boilers cycle for shipping or storage, separate from cleaning and descaling. Ask a used seller whether that cycle was completed, especially before freezing conditions. Follow the delivered BES995 instructions, not valve steps from older Oracle models. Checked October 21, 2026. [source]
note: BES995 US guide lists an Empty Boilers cycle for shipping or storage among separate maintenance functions.

removeTexts: The current bean has to be cleared from the grinder path before a strict decaf cup, and a small amount of previous grounds can remain. The machine’s Bean Switch prompts help manage that transition; they do not magically create two independent grinders.
html: Choose the cost of a bean switch: De'Longhi's EXAM44055B instructions offer a transition drink using the old beans or a Grind & Empty cycle that discards them. Switching without clearing mixes beans in the next cup. A regular-and-decaf household should budget that drink or waste; neither option proves zero residual caffeine. Follow the screen's sequence. Checked October 21, 2026. [source]
note: EXAM44055B instructions describe Choose the drink and Grind & Empty and warn of mixing if beans are not cleared.

removeTexts: A small purge can still be necessary after a major setting change when cross-dose carryover matters.
html: Plan the 078S as a single-dose grinder: Timemore lists a roughly 30 g hopper, 60-second auto-off and closed-lid advice to reduce popcorning. Larger filter batches need separate weighed charges; auto-off is not timed dosing. The 078S is stepless, unlike the stepped 078; confirm the suffix. Checked October 21, 2026. [source]
note: Timemore Sculptor FAQ: around 30 g hopper, 60-second auto-off, close lid, and stepless 078S versus stepped 078.
